verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page lists "Receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses", and its API covers receipts alongside card transactions. That points to mobile photo capture of receipts, but the evidence never describes OCR extraction, email forwarding, or automatic matching of a receipt to its card transaction. Missing for 10: email-forward receipt capture, documented OCR field extraction, automatic receipt-to-transaction matching, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
